caption: The drawing depicts a three-pronged metal tool, likely a pitchfork head, rendered in shades of brown and dark gray. The tool consists of a cylindrical socket at the top for attaching a handle, from which extend three elongated, slightly curved tines arranged in a horizontal row. The tines taper gradually to pointed ends. The object is centered on an off-white or beige background with no additional objects or details present. The coloration and shading suggest the metallic texture and aged appearance of the tool. There is a small handwritten inscription near the bottom center of the page.
title: Hay Fork
